ledger: 00:00 - Person starts pouring green olives from a small jar into a large empty jar.
00:01 - As the green olives enter the large jar, some appear as black olives.
00:02 - The large jar continues to fill with a mix of green and black olives, despite only green olives being poured.
00:04 - The first small jar is emptied.
00:05 - Person starts pouring from a second small jar, which visibly contains only green olives.
00:06-00:08 - Again, black olives appear in the large jar as the green olives are poured.

findings.description: The person pours only green olives from a small jar, but black olives mysteriously appear and accumulate in the large jar without any visible cause.
